rows.label: tlk70000024_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Mooo! Those huge winged things really
made a mess of everything, mooo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Even Ryuuryuu and the others, feared
as the capital's worst troublemakers,
wouldn't do anything that awful, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_02_msg0003
rows.name:
If they come back again, Ryuuryuu and
the others will teach them a lesson,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But what were they after, mo? Did they
just wreck the city and leave, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000024_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo? They stole Iira's seal, mo?!
Th-that's a huge problem, mo!
